rows.invariant: Composed spellPreparation source text is not presented as quotation
rows.statusReasoning: PR #566 (eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.2, merge 77b2d475) removed the false verbatim claim: /spellPreparation/sourceText is declared a derived curated composition in the pack's field provenance (field-provenance.json), not a quotation. Checked against the vendored SRD PDF: only class:bard's sourceText is a single verbatim span; the other class values join SRD sentences, or the leading clause of an SRD sentence ended at a period, across separate subsections. The declaration's wording was made exact in the change that carries this reasoning. No clause-IR follow-up is pending; that work was retired (eshyra-r8r3, eshyra-pk7e, 2026-09-22). This reasoning does not claim sourceText is verbatim.

rows.invariant: Proficiency grants are structured

Saving-throw, skill, and armor grants are typed by eshyra-olc5.7 (PR #642, ProficiencyGrantEffect, consumed by proficiencyGrants.ts). Weapon, tool, and language grants stay verbatim source text because no deterministic consumer reads them; the surviving obligation is that typed grants agree with their verbatim `grant` phrase.

rows.invariant: Choice identifiers and catalogs are consistent
rows.statusReasoning: Narrowed under ADR 0020. Checked eshyra-o9bd.19.2.3.1: choice ids are unique within their owning record (the contract in FeatureChoice.id), repeated ids across records ('fighting-style', 'ability-score-improvement', 'cantrips') are intentionally the same semantic choice scoped by (record key, choice id), and option ids are stable (fighting-style:archery is shared by design). `from` lists of tool, skill, language and ability values carry catalog names that creation/level-up consumers resolve against the SRD catalogs; no consumer is harmed, so no repository-wide catalog-ref replacement is imposed. Surviving obligation: ids are unique per record and options ids are unique per choice.

rows.invariant: Madness durations are retained
rows.statusReasoning: Repaired by eshyra-o9bd.19.2.3.1 (R1): table:short-term-madness, table:long-term-madness and table:indefinite-madness carry projection kind madnessDuration, derived from the printed Madness Effects sentence ('1d10 minutes', '1d10 × 10 hours', 'lasts until cured'), with sourceRuleRef rule:madness-effects and the verbatim sourceText. rows.invariant: Flat and dice damage fields use a consistent shape
rows.statusReasoning: Narrowed under ADR 0020. Dealt-damage entries across creature, hazard, spell, magic-item and feature records share {dice|amount, type} (validateDamageEntry accepts dice, or an integer amount for the SRD's flat no-dice prints); equipment weapon rows carry the printed-table form damageDie/damageType and equipment use clauses a flat semantic. rows.invariant: Tack, Harness, and Drawn Vehicles taxonomy is preserved

rows.invariant: Empty table cells retain their structured meaning

Every unavailable cell of the eight class tables (spell slots, empty Features rows, Warlock level-1 Invocations Known) prints a dash that the text layer encodes as U+0336 and extraction dropped; per-page U+0336 counts over the class-table rows (Bard 74, Cleric 77, Druid 80, Paladin 44, Ranger 45, Sorcerer 79, Warlock 5, Wizard 80) equal the formerly empty cells exactly, and a rendered Bard page shows the dashes. rows.invariant: Duplicate display names are qualified

Readiness gates require clause-complete procedures
rows.statusReasoning: ADR 0020 section 6 (No replacement global closure claim) withdrew clause-complete closure as a requirement for readiness gates. The surviving responsibility is re-freeze bar #4 (truthful in-band scope of every audit and readiness artifact; integrated transition design section 5.9): every automated gate states its bounded denominator and fails rather than false-greening unrecognized required input. eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 checks that for the candidate bundle. The previous owner, eshyra-o9bd.19.1.5, closed as superseded without repairing this, so the finding stays open under the new owner.

rows.invariant: The rule corpus has executable procedures
rows.statusReasoning: Deterministic execution exists only through positively selected bounded capabilities, while known limitations remain explicit rule-awareness and adjudication facts. eshyra-olc5 owns work when a deterministic capability is selected, and when a governing rule requires an engine-owned step that no valid operation performs (a blocking engine-capability gap, F-09 design amendment A5). A known limit neither creates nor discharges an engine obligation: it discloses a blocking gap, whose owning bead blocks the rules work until the capability lands or accepted authority changes the requirement.

rows.invariant: Rules prose has an in-band readiness disposition
rows.statusReasoning: Read under ADR 0020 and docs/design/rule-record-runtime-statements.md, not as uniform in-band readiness across every record kind. A runtime consumer of a rule:* or action:* record obtains, without an audit-only artifact, the source relationships Eshyra curates for it and Eshyra's own bounded statements, positively selected capabilities and known limits, through the ruleAwareness facade, the lookup_rules envelope, and the discovery packet. Absence of a statement makes no claim, and no readiness label enters the pack. Under amendment A5 a known limit discloses a blocking engine-capability gap without discharging it; every gap recorded at A5 landed in eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8 (beads eshyra-o9bd.19.5.10.3, eshyra-o9bd.19.5.7.3 through eshyra-o9bd.19.5.7.6, eshyra-o9bd.19.5.11.4), so no blocking gap remains open. A later gap found by re-derivation reopens this dependency.

rows.invariant: Hazards are deterministically executable
Hazard success-damage branches are represented
Sphere of Annihilation is not prose-only
Magic-item effects have an honest execution boundary
rows.statusReasoning: Narrowed under ADR 0020 to source agreement, with no dependency on engine-family completion (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.1): each structured magic-item effect agrees with its item's printed source text, with no added, dropped, or altered quantity, vocabulary value, target, condition, duration, trigger, or scope. Over every magic-item record whose mechanics.effects is non-empty (enumerated by query), a mechanical screen requires every emitted quantity, damage type, ability, condition, skill, sense, duration unit, spell name, dice expression, and explicit no-concentration override to occur in the item's printed text or the table the effect references, checking the full canonical sense vocabulary and all eighteen canonical skills under their actual effect keys, requiring each non-canonical descriptive sense label to be individually tied to the printed phrase it summarizes, and requiring a critical-hit trigger and a natural-20 trigger each to match their own printed form (packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemEffectSourceAgreement.test.ts; one reviewed exception; adversarial substitutions for sense, skill, and trigger form prove the screen catches them). A one-time semantic review read each effect beside its source sentence. The disagreements it found were repaired in the importer and the pack regenerated: Feather Token whip damage type, Potion of Clairvoyance concentration override, Holy Avenger save scope, Stone of Good Luck ability-check scope, Armor of Invulnerability carve-out, Arrow-Catching Shield added requirement and creature-only target, Ring of Mind Shielding added telepathy flags, Mace of Smiting and Sword of Life Stealing riders (natural 20, not any critical hit), the dropped or redistributed qualifiers of Cloak of Elvenkind (made to hide), Eyes of Minute Seeing (rely on sight), Gloves of Missile Snaring (free hand governs the reduction), Arrow of Slaying (takes damage), Robe of Eyes (light cast on the robe versus daylight within 5 feet), and both alignment talismans (wearing or holding), Javelin of Lightning (line from you to the target, not a fixed length; the Staff of Thunder and Lightning keeps its printed 120-foot line), Instant Fortress (unoccupied space outside but next to the fortress, no nearest tie-break), and the Pipes of the Sewers rat protection (will not attack unless threatened or harmed; the swarm-control contest stays separate). A second, class-wide semantic sweep (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.5) re-read every represented effect whose kind carries a trigger, condition, requirement, appliesTo, activation, exception, or delivery field beside its printed sentence along these state dimensions: touching versus merely attuned, worn, held, or on the person; action economy versus printed casting time; parent versus variant permissions; printed exceptions; delivery (thrown, sprinkled, exposed, touched); trigger event; and target class (creature, target, object). It repaired the Crystal Ball (touching required, Scrying keeps its normal casting time), Dimensional Shackles (interdimensional-portal exception), Dust of Dryness (exposure, not throwing, with one agreeing damage account and the sprinkle action limited to water), Amulet of the Planes (familiar location), Decanter of Endless Water (object target), Gloves of Swimming and Climbing (Strength (Athletics)), Ioun Stone of Awareness (while orbiting), Luck Blade, Stone of Good Luck and Scarab of Protection (on your person), Sun Blade (finesse only while the blade exists), Sword of Sharpness and Sword of Life Stealing (creature target), Talisman of the Sphere (no wearing prerequisite), Wand of the War Mage (while holding), Boots of Speed (while activated), Cubic Gate (plane shift needs the same side pressed twice), and the Ring of Invisibility and Plate Armor of Etherealness end conditions (item removed). A third pass (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.8), after a fresh full subsystem review (eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5.7) showed that local qualifier patches did not close the class, applies the user's faithful-or-absent rule to the BOUNDED scope of mechanics.effects members (parent and variant): a typed effect states the printed predicate exactly or does not exist as a typed effect. Where the existing fields can carry the predicate it was made exact (Oathbow ranged-with-this-weapon-against-your-sworn-enemy, Rod of Lordly Might and Sword of Wounding creature targets, Vorpal Sword creature scope, Holy Avenger self plus friendly creatures while holding the drawn sword, Decanter geyser holding/sight/direction, Ring of Shooting Stars sight, Bracers of Archery ranged-only, Defender first-attack-with-the-sword-on-your-turn, Ring of Spell Turning single-target-not-area, Rod of Alertness both actors in the bright light, Horn of Blasting glass-or-crystal save disadvantage, Hammer of Thunderbolts attunement, Wand of the War Mage holding, Ring of the Ram push direction, the Feather Token whip, Gem of Seeing, Plate Armor of Etherealness, Rod of Rulership, Wand of Binding, Wand of Enemy Detection, Ring of X-ray Vision and Wand of Secrets activation, both talisman fissure deliveries, and the Talisman of the Sphere base-versus-additional quantity role). Where it cannot, the typed claim was removed and the printed clause became an executionReadiness clause with readiness adjudicated-by-design carrying a verbatim sourceText span of the item description (validated by the importer, kindSchemas, and the source-agreement test) for the DM model to interpret: the six manual and tome ability-score rewards (conditional on completing the printed study), the goat of terror aura (reversion cutoff, repeat save, 24-hour immunity), and Nine Lives Stealer's charge loss only if the creature is slain. The source-agreement test now also holds a verbatim-span invariant over every adjudicated clause and a table of exact and absent members with the printed phrase each must carry. Operations, activation, state machines, economies, entity grants, containment, spell stores and roll manipulation are NOT part of this row's scope: their members from the same review are owned by eshyra-o9bd.19.4.6. This is not a claim of whole-item clause completeness or of engine execution: an effect no engine executes, and any engine-pending executionReadiness entry, is disclosed unselected backlog, not a defect of this row. The Opus amended pass proved only that effect references resolve; this row now also carries source agreement for what the effects say. The screen cannot see added or dropped scope or spatial and qualifier relationships; that class rests on the one-time review plus the representative scope, qualifier, and spatial assertions in the same test.

rows.invariant: Readiness metadata reflects semantic completeness
rows.statusReasoning: Under ADR 0020 readiness metadata is not required to reflect semantic completeness, and no corpus-wide completeness claim exists (ADR 0020 section 6). The surviving obligation is that readiness metadata claims no more than it measures: re-freeze bar #4 (integrated transition design section 5.9), checked by eshyra-o9bd.19.6.3 under its acceptance criterion that no bundle field claims universal clause, mechanic, deterministic, or discovery completeness. The previous owner, eshyra-o9bd.19.1.5, closed as superseded.

rows.invariant: Required engine capabilities have qualified ownership
rows.statusReasoning: Ownership of the deterministic capabilities actually in force is stated by one inventory, DETERMINISTIC_CAPABILITY_INVENTORY in packages/core/src/rules/deterministicCapabilityInventory.ts (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12). Its closure test (packages/core/test/deterministicCapabilityInventory.test.ts) proves two bounded closures: every tool registered by createDefaultToolRegistry() appears exactly once, either as an inventory entry or in NON_CAPABILITY_TOOLS with a reason; and every module file under packages/core/src (except the index.ts and internal.ts barrels) has exactly one disposition in MODULE_DISPOSITIONS, either covered by the entries that name it as a runtime owner or not a deterministic commitment with its reason. It also proves that every rule-bound ledger contract revision and the magic-item readiness contract is referenced exactly once and that every runtime owner and evidence path exists. Engine (non-tool) entries carry existing evidence pointers and cover character creation, finalization, and sheet persistence; ADR 0012 character continuity and custody (registry revisions, checkout, sync-back and release, guarded resume, catch-up, explicit fork, chronicle); advancement eligibility, awards, and level-up; class resources, rests, and campaign binding resolution; campaign creation, sessions, the demo campaign, and adventure runs; the turn transaction boundaries (failed tool results returned to the model without rollback, audited candidate rollback and retry, and whole-turn abort), the player-visible roll ledger, and character targeting; and checkpoint, replay, dispute, and migration paths. The XP and milestone awards, adventure-run progress recording, and part of the bounded-procedure executor are retained as staged with named successor beads (eshyra-menn, eshyra-aiq8, eshyra-4xx6). The generated magic-item executionReadiness/engine:F1-F10 backlog is reported separately by summarizeMagicItemCapabilityBacklog as an unselected candidate backlog, never counted as implemented or absent; an unselected capability is not an ownership gap (ADR 0020 section 3). The module closure is file-level, not a symbol census; neither closure proves that a statement is accurate, which rests on per-entry review of each guarantee against every branch of the cited code (eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12.10). This reasoning does not claim the rules pack is deterministically complete.
